initial_prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Asset: transparent 4:3 landscape PNG for a website hero.
Reference image 1: hardware design ONLY. Ignore its large scale, camera, cable arrangement, controller, background and composition.

PRIMARY REQUIREMENT: A genuinely FAR-AWAY view of two VERY SMALL wired earbuds, positioned exactly as though being worn by an invisible adult who faces the camera. The head and body are invisible and must NOT be rendered. Imagine a distant head-to-waist portrait, then show ONLY the two tiny earbuds and their long dangling wires.

CRITICAL SCALE AND PLACEMENT:
Use lots of completely transparent negative space. Each entire earbud INCLUDING fin and silicone tip should occupy ONLY 5–6% of total canvas width, approximately 75 pixels wide on a 1448-pixel-wide canvas. Earbuds must look TINY, not large product closeups.
Place their centres at x=34% and x=66%, both at the SAME y=23% of canvas height. Their horizontal centre-to-centre separation is about SIX times the width of one earbud: an anatomically plausible adult head width relative to actual earbud size.
Keep both at ear height, level and approximately symmetrical, as a real left/right pair worn by a person looking toward us. Silicone acoustic tips point INWARDS toward the empty space where the head would be: left-side bud tip points right; right-side bud tip points left. Outside faceplates face outward away from the imaginary head. Wings upright and seated naturally as in opposite ears. Show naturally foreshortened front/three-quarter views appropriate to this worn position, not two unrelated catalogue views. Do not stagger the buds vertically or enlarge them.

LONG CABLES:
Each earbud's own thin black braided cable emerges from its bottom and hangs separately down under gravity, approximately beneath its respective ear. Both wires run from about y=28% down to y=91%, with gently relaxed narrow curves. Each hanging wire should be roughly EIGHT times as long as the height of its earbud. Long, fine, nearly vertical cables are a central visual feature. Keep the two wires separate, never crossing, never joining, no horizontal loop. Solid and clear through most of their length, smoothly fading in ALPHA from y=77% to fully invisible at y=92%. No abruptly cut ends.

HARDWARE INVARIANTS: compact smoked-translucent charcoal shell, satin-black oval faceplate and thin champagne bezel, plain black silicone support fin, smoke-grey silicone tip. Keep the reference product design even though viewed from a distance. Natural premium soft studio illumination and accurate miniature hardware detail.

OUTPUT: true TRANSPARENT background, including all empty space between and around the tiny earbuds and long wires. Cable ends fade to actual alpha=0, to blend naturally onto a white or near-white webpage. No painted white fog, no white rectangular background, no checkerboard baked in.
Show ONLY the TWO tiny earbuds and TWO long dangling wires. No visible person, head, ears, body, silhouette, mannequin, outline, hands, controller, splitter, plug, case, floor, shadows, props, text, labels, logo, watermark or UI.
Do not zoom in. Do not fill the frame with the product. The requested distant composition and realistic wearing orientation take priority.
